question: What documents are required during registration at IIT Patna?
answer: You need: (1) JoSAA seat allocation letter, (2) Seat acceptance letter issued by JoSAA, (3) Proof of payment of seat acceptance fee, (4) AADHAR card, (5) Address proof, (6) Income certificate (only for tuition fee waiver seekers; not applicable for SC/ST/PwD candidates), (7) 10th Certificate & Marksheets, (8) 12th Certificate & Marksheets, (9) Transfer/Migration certificate from school, (10) SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS certificate in GoI format (if applicable), (11) PwD certificate (if applicable), (12) Medical fitness certificate with blood group report, (13) Declaration as submitted on academic ERP.

question: Is income certificate mandatory for all students?
answer: No. Income certificate is only required for students seeking tuition fee waiver or fee relaxation. It is NOT applicable for SC, ST, and PwD candidates.

question: What are the requirements for the income certificate?
answer: The income certificate must: (i) be issued by a Revenue office not below the rank of Tehsildar, (ii) include income from all family sources for financial year 2023-24, (iii) have been issued on or after 1st April 2023. Income tax return, Form 16, or Notary-issued certificates are NOT acceptable.

question: Is Transfer Certificate mandatory for online reporting?
answer: Transfer Certificate and Migration Certificate are not mandatory for online reporting, but they will be required at the time of physical reporting. Make sure to bring them on registration day.

question: What is the OBC-NCL and EWS certificate validity requirement?
answer: OBC-NCL and EWS certificates must have been issued on or after 1st April 2023 to be valid for registration.

question: What is the reporting date for new students at IIT Patna?
answer: The reporting date is 29th July 2024 (most probably). You will receive an official confirmation email from the college once JoSAA process is over.

question: Is there a specific reporting time I need to follow?
answer: There is no fixed reporting time. Just try to arrive during office hours.

question: What steps should I follow after getting IIT Patna allotted in JoSAA?
answer: Follow these steps: (1) Gather all documents — make 2 xerox copies and organize originals + copies in a file. (2) Wait for the official email from IIT Patna with a form link. (3) Fill the form. (4) Complete the fee payment on the payment gateway. (5) Arrange accommodation for your parents near/on campus. (6) Report to IIT Patna on the reporting date with all documents.

question: When will I get the offer letter / email from IIT Patna?
answer: You can expect the offer email 2–3 days after JoSAA ends. The email will contain instructions on fee payment, required documents, and registration details.

question: When will the freshers' WhatsApp/Telegram group be created?
answer: The freshers group, branch group, and all related student groups will be created after JoSAA process gets over.

question: Which hostel is allotted to freshers at IIT Patna?
answer: Girls are allotted Aryabhatta C Block with double occupancy. Boys are allotted CV Raman Hostel with triple occupancy.

question: When will hostel rooms be allotted to freshers?
answer: Hostel rooms can be allotted a day before registration (i.e., 28th July), provided you have paid the hostel fee in advance. Final allotment happens on 29th July after course registration.

question: How do I book the IIT Patna Guest House for my parents?
answer: Send an email to guest_off@iitp.ac.in, CC to pic_guest@iitp.ac.in and pcmandal@iitp.ac.in. Attach your seat allotment letter and mention the dates and times. Charges: Single occupancy ₹1200 + tax, Double occupancy ₹1800 + tax.

question: What is the cost of the IIT Patna Guest House?
answer: Guest house charges are ₹1200 + tax for single occupancy and ₹1800 + tax for double occupancy.

question: Which mobile network works best at IIT Patna campus?
answer: Both JIO and Airtel work well on campus. 5G connectivity is available and preferred for better speeds.

question: Which banks are available on the IIT Patna campus?
answer: SBI and Canara Bank are available on campus. There is also a Canara Bank ATM inside the campus.

question: Are online payments accepted at shops near IIT Patna?
answer: Yes, all shops on campus and nearby accept online payments. Some auto drivers also accept digital payments for short trips. It is recommended to set up PhonePe or Google Pay for convenience.

question: How do I pay my fees at IIT Patna?
answer: Pay the complete fee online as mentioned in the official email. Ensure your bank allows a single transaction of around ₹2 lakhs. Net banking is the preferred method. NEFT/cheque is also possible but not recommended as it can be hectic on registration day.

question: What is the fee structure for B.Tech first year at IIT Patna?
answer: For Indian National students in Semester 1: One-time Academic Fee ₹20,000, Hostel Academic Fee ₹5,000, Academic Fee ₹10,750, Tuition Fee ₹1,00,000, plus campus amenities (Hostel Establishment ₹6,500, Institute Resources ₹14,000, Gymkhana ₹5,000, Transport ₹1,500, Mess Advance ₹1,931, Health Insurance ₹2,000 tentative). Total approx. ₹1,83,781. For International/NRI/OCI students, tuition fee is ₹3,00,000.

question: Is there any tuition fee waiver for economically backward students?
answer: Yes. Students with family income below ₹1 lakh per annum get full tuition fee remission. Students with family income between ₹1 lakh and ₹5 lakhs per annum get 2/3rd remission of tuition fee. SC/ST/PH students also get complete tuition fee waiver.

question: Will the ₹30,000 paid to JoSAA be adjusted in my college fees?
answer: No. The ₹30,000 JoSAA fee is completely separate and will not be adjusted against your college fees. You must pay the full college fees as mentioned in the email. The JoSAA refund of ₹30,000 will be sent to your bank account within 2–3 months by JoSAA directly.

question: Are parents allowed on the registration day?
answer: Yes, parents are allowed on campus on registration day. They will also be required to sign a code of conduct document. Parents can also help you set up your hostel room.

question: Do parents need to stay until the orientation?
answer: No, it is not mandatory for parents to stay for the orientation. However, they are most welcome to attend if they wish.

question: What are the food arrangements for parents on campus?
answer: Parents can get food in the mess for a nominal charge. Students are also charged for mess until their hostel is allotted. If the guest house is full, parents can consider nearby hotels.

question: What format is required for the Medical Certificate?
answer: The medical certificate must be the same format submitted on the JoSAA portal. Ensure it has the doctor's stamp and signature. If the original lacks these, get a new certificate in the same format (with stamp) and bring both on registration day.

question: Do I need a stamp on my blood report?
answer: No, a stamp is not required on the blood report. However, make sure it is recent and not 5–6 years old. If you uploaded an old report on JoSAA, get a fresh one and bring both old and new reports on registration day.

question: What is Academic ERP and why is it needed?
answer: Academic ERP is a document covering the code of conduct and an agreement to IIT Patna's terms and conditions. It will be sent as an email attachment after the JoSAA process. You need to get it signed and bring it on registration day.

question: How do I reach IIT Patna campus from Patna city or Danapur?
answer: Three options: (1) Institute Buses — free for students with seat acceptance letter; parents pay ₹60/person. Bus stops at prime Patna locations (list shared near registration). (2) Bus Route 888 from Gandhi Maidan to IIT Patna Gate 1 — check timings on the 'Chalo' app. (3) Ola/Uber cabs — available but more expensive.

question: How do I reach IIT Patna from Bihta railway station?
answer: Auto-rickshaws are available from Bihta Station to IIT Patna campus at nominal charges. The station is approximately 3 km from the campus.

question: Is there a free bus from Patna for new students?
answer: Yes! Institute buses are available from prime locations in Patna for new students. Students can ride for free by showing their seat acceptance letter. Parents need to pay ₹60 per person. The bus stop list will be shared closer to registration dates.

question: Is branch change possible at IIT Patna?
answer: No. As per the latest institute policy, branch change is currently not allowed at IIT Patna. Students are advised to choose their branch carefully during JoSAA counselling.

question: What is the average CTC for CSE students at IIT Patna in 2024?
answer: The average CTC for CSE (Computer Science and Engineering) students in the 2024 batch was approximately ₹21,64,859 per annum.

question: What is the average CTC for EEE students at IIT Patna?
answer: The average CTC for EEE (Electrical and Electronics Engineering) students in the 2024 batch was approximately ₹14,47,849 per annum.

question: What is the average placement package for Mechanical Engineering at IIT Patna?
answer: The average CTC for Mechanical Engineering (ME) students in the 2024 batch was approximately ₹10,13,510 per annum.

question: What is the average CTC for CBE (Chemical & Biochemical Engineering) at IIT Patna?
answer: The average CTC for CBE students in the 2024 batch was approximately ₹12,58,381 per annum.

What was the placement percentage for CSE in the 2022 batch?
answer: In the 2022 B.Tech batch, the CSE department had 100% placement. Out of 66 interested students, all 66 were placed, receiving 107 total offers with a highest CTC of ₹1.37 crore, average CTC of ₹38.79 LPA, and median CTC of ₹40 LPA.

question: What was the highest placement package at IIT Patna in the 2022 batch?
answer: The highest CTC in the 2022 B.Tech placement was ₹1.37 crore, achieved by the CSE department. The overall batch placement percentage was 96.19%.

question: What should I bring from home for bedding?
answer: Bring: Mosquito net and repellants (H), Bedsheets/mattress cover — at least 2 pairs (H), Pillow covers (H), Blankets — needed in late Nov and Jan-Feb (H), Shawl (H). Mattress and pillow are available on campus (C).

question: Can I buy a mattress on campus at IIT Patna?
answer: Yes! Mattresses are available in stalls set up near the hostels on arrival. You only need to bring one from home if you have special needs or are a local student.

question: Are electric kettles or heating rods allowed in hostel rooms?
answer: No. Electric kettles, electric water heating rods, heaters, and similar electronic heating items are NOT allowed in hostel rooms. The institute has made alternate arrangements to meet these needs.

question: What stationery should I bring to IIT Patna?
answer: Most stationery (pens, pencils, notebooks, cello tape, glue) is available on campus. Bring a scientific calculator from home as variety is limited on campus. Also bring scissors, a stapler, and any extra stationery you have.

question: Is a scientific calculator compulsory at IIT Patna?
answer: Yes, a scientific calculator is essential and compulsory for labs and exams. Although it is available on campus, the variety is limited. It is better to bring one from home or order online in advance.

question: What personal care items should I bring?
answer: Most personal care items (toothbrush, toothpaste, soap, hand wash, shampoo, hair oil, bucket/mug, vaseline) are available on campus. Bring: soap case, ropes and clips for drying clothes, nail cutter, medicines/first aid kit, and extra spectacles if applicable.

question: Should I bring a first aid kit to the hostel?
answer: Yes, it is strongly recommended to keep a first aid box in your room with common medicines, bandages, band-aids, thermometer, safety pins, antiseptics, and pain relief creams (Volini, Moov, Iodex). The campus hospital provides free medicines but having first aid handy can help in emergencies.

question: What footwear do I need to bring to IIT Patna?
answer: Bring: Sports shoes (compulsory for sports), comfortable slippers, non-marking shoes (for indoor sports like TT/badminton and gym), and full-covered shoes with good grip (compulsory for certain labs for safety reasons). All genders need full-covered shoes for lab safety.

question: What clothes should I bring to IIT Patna?
answer: Bring full-covering clothes for lab safety (covering hands and legs, not loose or hanging), t-shirts, shirts (4–6 half and full sleeved), pants/jeans, shorts, lower, belt, towels, undergarments, sweaters (2 full + 1 half sleeved), jackets, lab coat, and 4–5 hangers. Full-sleeved shirts are mandatory for some labs.

question: Is there a swimming pool at IIT Patna? Should I bring swimming gear?
answer: No, there is currently no swimming pool at IIT Patna. Swimming gear is not required.

question: What electronics should I bring to IIT Patna?
answer: Bring: Mobile phone + charger (preferably dual-SIM), earphones/headphones, alarm clock, table lamp, laptop stand, USB cable, pen drives/hard disks if needed. Note: Electric kettles, heaters, and rods are NOT allowed.

question: Should I bring a bicycle to IIT Patna?
answer: Bicycles are available for purchase on campus on arrival with sufficient options to choose from. The campus is 501 acres so having a bicycle is very useful. You can buy one here rather than bringing from home.

question: Should I bring an umbrella or raincoat?
answer: Yes, definitely! The first semester is called the 'monsoon semester' for a reason. Bring an umbrella (more convenient) or a raincoat.

question: Do I need to bring locks for the hostel room?
answer: Yes, bring locks for your room, cycle, and almirah (cupboard), plus one extra. Keep spare keys in a safe place. Locks are also available on campus.

question: Should I bring a laptop stand?
answer: It depends on your preference, but it is recommended to avoid keeping laptops in your lap for health reasons, as the heat emitted can affect fertility over time.

question: Is laundry service available at IIT Patna?
answer: Yes, a paid laundry service is available on campus. Laundry workers come twice a week. Washing machines (both semi-automatic and fully-automatic) are also available in the hostels. Bring washing detergent/soap powder and a scrubber.

question: Can I order items online (Amazon/Flipkart) at IIT Patna?
answer: Yes! Delivery personnel from Amazon/Flipkart come to campus daily. However, Prime or 1–2 day guaranteed deliveries may not always apply, so plan accordingly.

question: Should I bring sports equipment to IIT Patna?
answer: You can bring your own bat, racquets, balls, or other sports gear. Alternatively, sports equipment can also be issued from the sports chamber on campus.

question: Do I need to bring water bottles?
answer: Yes, bring water bottles. There are common water coolers on each floor of the hostel.

question: Should I bring sports shoes to IIT Patna?
answer: Yes, sports shoes are compulsory for all sports-related activities at IIT Patna. Make sure to bring a good pair from home.

question: Do I need a dual-SIM phone at IIT Patna?
answer: A dual-SIM phone is recommended. Most students keep two SIMs — one local (for IIT Patna area) and one from their home state. Purchase SIM cards from home if possible. Also consider keeping a spare/backup phone.

question: Do I need to bring bedsheets and pillow covers?
answer: Yes, bring at least 2 pairs of bedsheets/mattress covers from home. Pillow covers are also available on campus, but bringing your own is recommended.

question: Do I need to bring a lab coat?
answer: If you have a full-sleeved lab coat at home, bring it. Otherwise, you can borrow one from seniors or buy it in Patna.

question: Should I bring a torch/flashlight?
answer: Yes, it is recommended to bring a torch as it can come in handy during power cuts or emergencies.

question: Do I need to bring blankets and sweaters for winter?
answer: Yes. Blankets are needed in late November and January-February. Bring them from home if you have one. Also pack at least 2 full-sleeved sweaters and 1 half-sleeved, or jackets if you prefer those instead.

question: Is there a hospital or medical facility on campus?

question: Can I buy things in Bihta near IIT Patna?
answer: Yes! There is a town named Bihta right beside the campus where you can purchase most required items. Many essentials not available on campus can be found there.

question: How many copies of documents should I bring on registration day?
answer: Make 2 xerox copies of all documents. Organize them in a file with all originals and 2 sets of photocopies.

question: What was the average CTC for MME (Metallurgy & Materials Engineering) at IIT Patna in 2024?

question: What was the overall placement percentage for the 2022 B.Tech batch at IIT Patna?

question: Can I pay the IIT Patna fee by cheque or NEFT?
answer: Yes, NEFT and cheque payments are accepted but are not recommended. They can become very hectic to process on registration day. Online payment through the portal via net banking is strongly preferred.

question: What is the transaction limit I need for fee payment?
answer: Make sure your bank allows a single transaction of about ₹2 lakhs, as this is needed to complete the fee payment on the college portal in one transaction.

question: When will the freshers' hostel room be formally allocated?
answer: Hostel rooms are formally allotted on 29th July after your course registration is completed. Make sure your hostel fee is paid beforehand to enable allotment on 28th July.

question: Is there an ATM on the IIT Patna campus?
answer: Yes, there is a Canara Bank ATM inside the IIT Patna campus.

question: Should I register on PhonePe or Google Pay before coming to IIT Patna?
answer: Yes, it is very convenient to have a bank account and register on PhonePe or Google Pay before arriving. All campus shops and most auto drivers accept digital payments.

question: How much do parents need to pay to board the institute bus?
answer: Parents need to pay ₹60 per person to board the institute bus. Students can ride for free by showing their seat acceptance letter.

question: How can I check timings for Bus Route 888 to IIT Patna?
answer: Check the timings for Bus Route 888 (Gandhi Maidan to IIT Patna Gate 1) on the 'Chalo' app, available on the Play Store.

question: Can I switch from BS to B.Tech at IIT Patna?
answer: No. There is no provision for branch change from BS to B.Tech at IIT Patna.

question: Should I bring a school bag or laptop bag to IIT Patna?
answer: Bring the bag you have been using. You'll want a comfortable, practical backpack that can carry books and a laptop. Most students prefer a good quality laptop backpack.

question: Do I need to bring cloth drying ropes and clips?
answer: Ropes for hanging clothes are mostly already present in common areas. Bring cloth drying clips and an extra rope if you want to set one up in your room.

question: Do I need to bring extra spectacles?
answer: Yes, if you wear spectacles, it is recommended to bring an extra pair along, in case your primary pair breaks or gets misplaced.

question: Should I bring full-sleeved clothing for labs?
answer: Yes. Full-covering clothes (covering complete hands and legs, not loose or hanging) are a compulsory safety requirement for certain labs. This applies to all genders. Bring both full-sleeved shirts and appropriate pants.

question: Do I need to bring the Academic ERP form signed?
answer: Yes. The Academic ERP document (code of conduct and terms & conditions agreement) will be emailed to you after JoSAA. Get it signed and bring it on the day of registration.

question: Is health insurance compulsory at IIT Patna?
answer: Health insurance is mandatory. The fee is payable annually only if you purchase it through the institute. Otherwise, students must provide their own insurance details while reporting.

question: Is there a mess on campus for students?
answer: Yes, there is a mess on campus. Students are charged for meals in the mess from arrival until hostel allotment. A mess advance fee is included in the first semester fee structure.

answer: Bringing a few newspapers is useful for lining your cupboard. Plastic bags are also always handy for various small tasks in the hostel.

question: Can MBA students opt for branch change at IIT Patna?
answer: No. Branch change is NOT available for MBA students at IIT Patna.

question: How long does JoSAA take to refund the ₹30,000?
answer: JoSAA processes the ₹30,000 refund within 2–3 months after you join. The refund goes to the bank account you provided on the JoSAA website. It is handled entirely by JoSAA, not IIT Patna.

question: Do I need to fill an online form after JoSAA allotment?
answer: Yes. After your IIT Patna allotment, you will receive an email from the college with a form. Fill the form and complete the fee payment through the payment gateway linked in the email.

question: Is hostel fee payment required before room allotment?
answer: Yes. To get your hostel room allotted before registration day (on 28th July), you must have paid the hostel fee beforehand.

question: What was the median CTC for EEE students in the 2022 batch?
answer: The median CTC for EEE (Electrical Engineering) students in the 2022 batch was ₹25.56 LPA, with a highest CTC of ₹1.20 crore and average of ₹33.04 LPA.

question: Are there washing machines available in the hostel?
answer: Yes, both semi-automatic and fully-automatic washing machines are available in the hostels for student use.

question: Are there water coolers in the hostel?
answer: Yes, there are common water coolers on each floor of the hostel. Bring your own water bottles to fill up.

question: What should I do if my 10th certificate does not mention my date of birth?
answer: If your Date of Birth (DOB) is not mentioned on your 10th certificate, you need to bring a DOB certificate issued by the appropriate Government Authority.

question: What email address should I write to for booking the IIT Patna Guest House?
answer: Send your booking request to guest_off@iitp.ac.in with a CC to pic_guest@iitp.ac.in and pcmandal@iitp.ac.in. Attach your seat allotment letter and mention the required dates and duration.

question: Is a Declaration form needed for registration at IIT Patna?
answer: Yes. A Declaration (as submitted on the academic ERP) is one of the required documents (Point XIII) for registration. You will receive it by email after JoSAA and need to get it signed before reporting.

question: What miscellaneous items should I bring to IIT Patna hostel?
answer: Useful miscellaneous items: bicycle (or buy on campus), water bottles, locks (for room, cycle, almirah + extra), cloth drying clips, rope to hang clothes, umbrella/raincoat, sports equipment, newspapers (for cupboard lining), plastic bags, torch, and dusting cloth.

question: Do parents need to sign any document on registration day?
answer: Yes. Parents who come to campus on registration day are required to sign a code of conduct document.

question: Can I change from a 4-year B.Tech to a 5-year program at IIT Patna?
answer: No. Branch change at IIT Patna is only permitted within the same duration — 4-year to 4-year B.Tech, or 5-year to 5-year program. Cross-duration changes are not allowed.

question: What happens in JoSAA Round 6?
answer: Round 6 is the final IIT round. If you already hold a seat from Round 5, it remains safe unless upgraded. You do NOT lose your previous seat by participating in Round 6. Withdrawal after Round 6 is generally not possible for IITs.

question: Can IIT Patna EP cutoff increase heavily this year?
answer: Nobody can predict exact cutoffs. Inflation in mock predictors/data does not guarantee the same increase in actual JoSAA rounds. Round 6 generally sees some movement due to withdrawals and upgrades.

question: Should I trust Mathongo or online cutoff predictors completely?
answer: No. Use them only as rough indicators. Actual cutoffs depend on: preferences filled, seat movement, withdrawals, category-wise trends, and that year's counselling behavior. Never rely on predictors blindly.

question: Should I prioritize branch or IIT tag during counselling?
answer: It depends on your interests, career goals, whether you prefer coding/core/research/management, and your willingness to work outside academics. Branch affects your daily life and long-term specialization. College gives initial exposure, network, and opportunities. There is no single right answer — talk to seniors in your shortlisted branches.

question: What is Engineering Physics (EP) actually about?
answer: EP combines Physics, Mathematics, and Electronics/computing exposure with research-oriented learning. It is an interdisciplinary branch that bridges core physics with modern technology applications.

question: Is Engineering Physics (EP) good for placements?
answer: Yes, but it requires personal effort. Core EP jobs directly after B.Tech are fewer. Many students go towards Tech/SDE, AI/ML, Quant finance, Research, or Higher studies (MS/PhD). EP students who prepare well for coding land good tech jobs.

question: Is Engineering Physics considered a circuital branch at IIT Patna?
answer: Yes. Seniors at IIT Patna have mentioned that EP is now considered circuital for several placement and opportunity purposes, giving EP students access to tech company eligibility similar to EE/ECE branches.

question: Is Engineering Physics workload very high?
answer: Compared to EE/ECE, EP workload is usually lighter, but it is still mathematically intensive. Expect heavy coursework in physics and mathematics, but less lab burden than pure electrical branches.

question: Is Engineering Physics good for research?
answer: Very good for research. EP is strongly aligned toward Physics research, Quantum computing, AI/ML foundations, Higher studies abroad (MS/PhD), and interdisciplinary research. It is one of the most research-oriented branches at IIT Patna.

question: What core opportunities exist for Engineering Physics (EP) students?
answer: Core opportunities for EP students include: Research labs, Higher studies (MS/PhD), Physics-related govt jobs, BARC (Bhabha Atomic Research Centre), Quantitative/finance fields, and Semiconductor/research domains.

question: Is EEE (Electrical Engineering) very difficult at IIT Patna?
answer: Yes, EEE is considered one of the toughest branches academically. Reasons include heavy coursework, rigorous lab sessions, intensive subjects, and significant time pressure. Students should be mentally prepared for the workload before choosing EEE.

question: Does EEE have good placements at IIT Patna?
answer: Yes. EEE has strong placement opportunities in core electrical, electronics, and tech/SDE roles. The branch is circuital and eligible for many top tech companies. However, the workload is heavy.

question: Is the dual degree EEE program worth it at IIT Patna?
answer: Depends on your interests. Advantages: better core depth and possible edge in core placements. Disadvantages: heavy workload and 5-year commitment. Only choose it if you are genuinely interested in electrical engineering.

question: Can EEE students get SDE/software jobs at IIT Patna?
answer: Yes. EEE is a circuital branch and students are often eligible for tech/SDE roles at many companies. Coding preparation must be done independently alongside academics.

question: Is Mechanical Engineering good for placements at IIT Patna?
answer: Yes, if you build skills properly and explore coding, research, or core opportunities according to your interests. Mechanical has broad industrial relevance and good core placement opportunities.

question: Can Mechanical Engineering students get software/SDE jobs?
answer: Yes, Mechanical students can get software jobs, but it requires doing coding preparation separately and independently. Tech preparation is self-driven. Some companies may restrict eligibility for non-circuital branches.

question: Is Mechanical Engineering easier than EEE at IIT Patna?
answer: Generally yes. Mechanical is considered less brutal than EEE, but it is still not easy. The workload is manageable compared to electrical branches, but still demands consistent effort.
keywords: which is harder mech or EE

question: What is Mechatronics at IIT Patna?
answer: Mechatronics is an interdisciplinary branch combining Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Automation, and Robotics/control systems. It is ideal for students interested in robotics, smart manufacturing, and automation.

question: Is Mechatronics better than Mechanical Engineering at IIT Patna?
answer: There is no universal answer. Mechatronics is better if you are specifically interested in robotics, automation, and interdisciplinary systems. Mechanical Engineering is broader, more established, and has more industry recognition. Choose based on your specific interests.
keywords: mechatronics or mech which to choose

question: Are BTech + MBA dual degrees worth it at IIT Patna?
answer: Only if you genuinely want management and business exposure. Do NOT take MBA dual just because of branch attraction or peer pressure. Seniors strongly advise against choosing MBA dual purely for a 'backup' or to avoid a branch you don't like.

question: Can I still go into core engineering after an MBA dual degree?
answer: Not really ideal. MBA dual naturally pushes toward management and business side. If you are sure about core engineering, a pure B.Tech program is more suitable.
keywords: can I do engineering after MBA dual

question: What is the total fee for BTech + MBA (IIT + IIM) dual degree?
answer: Approximately ₹19–20 lakh or more in total, depending on the IIM specialization and any fee hikes. This is significantly higher than a standard B.Tech program.

question: Is IIT Patna campus life boring?
answer: Most seniors say NO. IIT Patna has active clubs, committees, cultural events, tech fests, DJ nights, and student activities throughout the year. The experience depends heavily on your own involvement.

question: What events and fests happen at IIT Patna?
answer: Popular events at IIT Patna include: Celesta (tech fest), Anwesha (cultural fest), Infinito, TEDx IIT Patna, DJ nights, and various club and committee activities throughout the year.

question: Is the online negativity about IIT Patna true?
answer: It is partially exaggerated, according to seniors. Every IIT has pros and cons. The experience depends heavily on your own involvement. Seniors advise not to panic based on internet reviews or Reddit posts — talk to actual current students instead.

question: How is the mess food at IIT Patna?
answer: Reviews are mixed. Some students like it, others don't. Quality can vary by mess and semester. Mess committees involve students and menus can be changed through proper channels.

question: Can students change or influence the mess menu?
answer: Yes. Mess committees involve student representatives, and the menu can be changed through the proper student-mess committee channels.

question: What are circuital branches at IIT Patna?
answer: Circuital branches are those related to Electronics, Electrical, and Computing. Examples at IIT Patna: CSE, AI/DS, ECE, EEE, Mathematics & Computing (MnC), and sometimes Engineering Physics (EP). These branches typically have higher eligibility for tech company placements.

question: Can non-circuital branch students still get tech/software jobs?
answer: Absolutely yes, but it requires more self-effort. Some companies may restrict eligibility for non-circuital branches. Strong coding skills and competitive programming preparation can overcome branch disadvantage.

question: Does branch completely decide placement outcomes at IIT Patna?
answer: No. Skills matter massively after a point. Branch can influence initial opportunities and eligibility, but long-term career outcomes depend much more on your individual skills, coding ability, and preparation.

question: Which branches are best for research at IIT Patna?
answer: It depends on the field: EP → Physics/interdisciplinary research; EE/ECE → Electronics/VLSI; Mechanical → Manufacturing/robotics; AI/DS/CSE → ML/AI systems. IIT Patna has active research groups across all departments.

question: Is higher education (MS/PhD) common after Engineering Physics at IIT Patna?
answer: Yes, very common. EP is strongly aligned toward MS, PhD, and research careers. Many EP graduates from IIT Patna pursue higher studies at top universities in India and abroad.

question: Is research possible at IIT Patna?
answer: Definitely yes. IIT Patna has growing research programs, active faculty, and opportunities in various departments. Students can participate in research projects, internships, and collaborations from early on.

question: Should I choose my branch only based on placements?
answer: Most seniors advise against this. You will study that branch for 4–5 years. Burnout is real if you genuinely dislike the subject. Choose based on a balance of interest, career goals, and placement prospects.

question: Is IIT Patna growing in terms of opportunities and recognition?
answer: Yes. Several juniors and seniors have mentioned growing placement opportunities, increasing industry recognition, and improving campus infrastructure at IIT Patna over recent years.

question: What is the final advice from seniors for counselling decisions?
answer: Key senior advice: (1) Don't panic based on internet negativity. (2) Don't blindly follow hype or trends. (3) Talk to multiple seniors from different branches. (4) Your personal effort matters more than any random online comparison. (5) No branch guarantees success automatically — you have to work for it.

question: Is there a perfect counselling choice in JoSAA?
answer: No. Every choice in JoSAA involves tradeoffs between branch, college, workload, placements, and personal interest. The 'best' choice is the one that aligns with your specific goals and interests after careful thought.

question: Should I blindly trust Reddit reviews about IIT Patna?
answer: No. Reddit reviews are often biased, exaggerated, or outdated. Rely on direct conversations with current students and seniors at IIT Patna for accurate, updated information.

question: Is registration day at IIT Patna very hectic?
answer: Yes! Registration day is very hectic. To prepare: organize all documents in advance, ensure all payments are complete, make 2 xerox copies of every document, and arrive at the campus well-prepared and early.

question: Can I enter the hostel before official registration at IIT Patna?
answer: Generally yes, if your hostel fees are already paid. You may be able to move into your room a day early, but this is subject to availability and official confirmation.

question: Is branch change available at IIT Patna? (Updated answer)
answer: According to multiple senior helpdesk sources, branch change is generally NOT available at IIT Patna. Some older FAQs mentioned limited availability, but current senior consensus from the helpdesk group confirms no branch change provision. Please verify with the academic office for the latest official policy.

question: Are placement stats enough to decide which branch to choose?
answer: No. Seniors repeatedly advise against choosing a branch purely based on placement statistics. Stats represent averages and don't account for individual skills, effort, interests, and the varied career paths students take.
keywords: should I choose branch based on stats

question: Is coding and competitive programming possible from every branch?
answer: Yes, coding is possible from every branch at IIT Patna. However, balancing coding preparation with branch-specific coursework differs — some branches (like EEE) have heavier academic load, making it harder to find time for coding.

question: What wings exist under the ACC (Academic Council Committee)?
answer: There are five wings under ACC: (1) Academic Wing, (2) Career Development Wing, (3) Research Wing, (4) Finance Wing, and (5) Web, Media and Publicity Wing. Each wing handles specific student support areas.

question: Who can I contact for career guidance at IIT Patna?
answer: IIT Patna has a Student Mentorship Program for this purpose. You can reach out to your assigned mentors and co-mentors for career guidance, academic advice, and general support.

question: Does ACC provide research opportunities for students?
answer: Yes! The Research & Development Wing of ACC helps students find research projects, internships, and collaborations with faculty and external organizations.

question: How can I get involved in Public Relations and Outreach at IIT Patna?
answer: You can get involved by joining events, campaigns, and media outreach initiatives organized by the Web, Media and Publicity Wing of ACC.

question: Where can I check my grades at IIT Patna?
answer: Go to Moodle → Dashboard → B.Tech Batch → Scroll to Current Semester to view your grades.

question: Where can I download my transcript at IIT Patna?
answer: Go to: Moodle Dashboard → All Courses → 202X Batch → PQR Branch → PQR Branch → Top Right block drawer → Orange Icon → My Total Credits. This will show your full transcript.

question: What should I do if a grade is missing or wrong in my transcript?
answer: First, update the semester manually in your Moodle profile. If the issue is still unresolved, mail AR Academic at aracademic@iitp.ac.in.

question: I need an urgent transcript for an internship application. Who do I contact?
answer: Contact UGR (Under Graduate Registration) directly for urgent transcript requests related to internships or external applications.

question: Where can I find the Academic Calendar of IIT Patna?
answer: Check the official IIT Patna website (iitp.ac.in) for the latest Academic Calendar PDF. It contains all important dates including exams, holidays, and registration deadlines.

question: When will semester results be released at IIT Patna?
answer: Contact AR Academic (aracademic@iitp.ac.in) for the result release timeline. Results dates are also sometimes mentioned in the Academic Calendar on the official IITP website.

question: When are supplementary exams held at IIT Patna?
answer: Check the Academic Calendar for supplementary exam dates. They are usually held after the even semester ends.

question: What is the criteria to appear for supplementary exams at IIT Patna?
answer: Students with CPI less than 5 are eligible for supplementary exams. IADC (Institute Academic Disciplinary Committee) cases are usually handled the next academic year.

question: What should I do if I missed an exam at IIT Patna?
answer: For medical reasons: provide a prescription/medical certificate and formally request a make-up exam from your professor. For non-medical reasons: request the professor directly and forward an application through the academic hierarchy (Dean Academic's office).

question: What happens if I get caught cheating in an exam at IIT Patna?
answer: Strict punishment applies. You will appear before IADC (Institute Academic Disciplinary Committee) and the penalty will be decided by the committee. Consequences can range from grade penalty to suspension.

question: I got debarred due to low attendance — what should I do?
answer: Request your professor for a make-up or supplementary option. If the reason is medical, provide medical proof (prescription/certificate). You may need to apply through the academic hierarchy depending on the extent of shortage.

question: What is the semester course registration procedure at IIT Patna?
answer: Enroll via Moodle Dashboard → All Courses → BTech Semester Course. An offline form may also be provided in some cases. Ensure registration is done before the deadline mentioned in the Academic Calendar.

question: What documents are required for semester registration at IIT Patna?
answer: You need: (1) Fee receipt (proof of fee payment), and (2) Income Certificate (required every odd semester for fee waiver/scholarship purposes).

question: Should the income certificate be renewed every semester at IIT Patna?
answer: Yes, the income certificate must be renewed every odd semester. Make sure to get a fresh one issued before each odd semester registration deadline.

question: I paid my fees but the portal is not showing it as updated. What do I do?
answer: Mail AcadBTech and CC AIS Support with your payment proof. They will manually verify and update the fee status in the portal.

question: My mess fees are not updated in the portal. Who should I contact?
answer: Inform AIS Support, AcadBTech, and the SA (Student Affairs) Office about the issue with your payment proof. All three need to be notified for mess fee discrepancies.

question: How can I get an extension on the fee payment deadline at IIT Patna?
answer: Mail the Adean Academic UG and CC (copy) to DR Academic and AcadBTech with a valid reason for the extension request. Include supporting documents if applicable.

question: Where do I upload my income certificate at IIT Patna?
answer: Upload the income certificate on the AIS Portal. Make sure to do this before the odd semester registration deadline.

question: How do I get the MCM (Merit-cum-Means) Scholarship at IIT Patna?
answer: Mail AR Academic (aracademic@iitp.ac.in) to inquire about and apply for the MCM Scholarship. Eligibility is based on academic merit and family income criteria.

question: How do I get a Bonafide Certificate at IIT Patna?
answer: Pay the required fee via SBI Collect and then submit the payment receipt to AR Academic (aracademic@iitp.ac.in) to get your Bonafide Certificate issued.

question: How do I get my degree certificate after graduation from IIT Patna?
answer: Fill in the degree certificate form available on the IITP Academic website, then mail the payment receipt to AcadBTech to initiate the degree certificate process.

question: Where can I find application templates for official academic work at IIT Patna?
answer: Use the SoAP (Standard of Academic Procedure) templates provided by the Academic Section of IIT Patna. These templates cover standard applications for leave, make-up exams, grade disputes, and other official requests.

question: What is the average CTC for CEE (Civil Engineering) at IIT Patna in 2024?
answer: The average CTC for CEE (Civil and Environmental Engineering) students in the 2024 batch was approximately ₹11,62,326 per annum.

question: How can I register for campus placements at IIT Patna?
answer: Contact the Career Development Cell (CDC) or the Career Development Wing of ACC for placement registration details. Keep your resume ready in the official IIT Patna format and register before deadlines announced by CDC.

question: What is the official resume format for IIT Patna placements?
answer: IIT Patna provides two official resume templates: (1) Google Slides Template — https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1NJXFVM8HsHpLi5mhjGO2Cm0lOGuTbKe2vSn93sbyLjQ/edit (2) Overleaf LaTeX Template — https://www.overleaf.com/latex/templates/iit-patna-resume/ddnnnxjgzckp. Use these for all placement and internship applications.

question: What is the average CTC for AI/DS (Artificial Intelligence & Data Science) branch at IIT Patna?
answer: Specific AI/DS branch placement statistics are not separately published yet as the branch is relatively new. For updated stats, contact the CDC or check with seniors from the AI/DS batch.

question: Where can I find research internship resources at IIT Patna?
answer: Refer to these GitHub repositories maintained by students: (1) Research-Internships-for-Undergraduates and (2) Summer Research Internship Programs. The Research Wing of ACC also helps connect students with internship opportunities.

question: How can I participate in research projects at IIT Patna?
answer: You can participate in research projects by: (1) Directly contacting faculty members whose research interests align with yours, or (2) Joining the Research Wing of ACC which helps connect students with ongoing faculty projects and external collaborations.
